title: Clarify sign-off evidence and scope changes for SSO/RBAC/KMS in Private Deploy
creator: Maya Chen
description: Short PRD addendum: We require precise artifacts and tests for SSO (SAML/OIDC), tenant-scoped RBAC, KMS/HSM evidence and audit logging for Private deployments. This ticket clarifies acceptance artifacts, documents a recent scope change requested by Compliance, and lists a sign-off checklist for operator/onboarding teams.
acceptance_criteria: Signed SAML metadata export for customer tenancy (including entityID, fingerprints) stored in audit trail and referenced in runbook
RBAC: role mapping matrix covering 8 operator roles and 4 customer roles with mapping tests that demonstrate least-privilege enforcement (automated integration tests against a staging VPC)
KMS/HSM: proof of customer-managed key wrap using external KMS (customer key wrapped by HSM with attestation) and rotation test that preserves decryptability within zero-downtime window
Audit logs: tamper-evident append-only export for authn/authz events and KMS key usage; retention policy implemented and validated by replay test
SSO failover: documented assertion replay protection and an emergency SAML bypass procedure validated in one full failover drill
Evidence packaging: every artifact must include an evidence manifest (SHA256 checksums), owner, timestamp and link to storage (GCS path) for sign-off
decision_log: 2025-02-12: Compliance requested additional HSM attestation artifacts — accepted; added KMS wrapping test to scope
2025-02-14: Scoped RBAC to tenant-scoped roles only; cross-tenant admin actions require explicit escalation workflow
2025-02-17: Agreement to use append-only CloudAudit export and store immutable snapshots in secure bucket with retention of 7 years for enterprise customers
